story_review.one_viewing_summary: Intended chain from the code, read largely from above. On the room plan the door leaf swings shut with its bell, footprints lead from the host stand out the door, and the apron swings beside the stand. The desk phone then rings at the empty stand, and the pad's top sheet curls and falls back blank while a guest raises a hand over an empty plate. An empty sign frame hangs on the glass and the host panel beside the stand lights and writes Haniya, then an AI host tag hooks onto its eyelet. Overhead, a hand lifts the phone over the table code, the brackets lock and the menu opens. Over her shoulder, the seated guest taps Chow mein with her own jointed arm, then Pay becomes the paid mark in a held detail. The camera follows the mark across the plan into the printer, the lamp turns red, the ticket rises and hangs, and the cook pours noodles as the flame flares. The ledger card takes the $9,650 a month tag and an OWNER COUNT stamp beside a RECEIPTS clip that snaps shut on nothing. Coins slide off the paid phone across the pass into the jar under a FOX 26 tag. The rule card's cooks line lights and is circled. The restaurant folder opens on a blank box and a question mark. A hand raises the phone toward the code, hesitates, sets it down and rests on it as a customer quote card lands. The panel takes an order whose slip drops into the printer, and the jar ends under owner says and no record shown tags beneath the printed ticket.
story_review.opening_to_ending: It opens on the walkout and the unattended station, asking who will take the order. It ends with the panel taking the order, the order printing, and the tip jar under owner says and no record shown. That answers the question within the source limits, and no resolved tip outcome is invented.
